queries.query:
with s as (
  find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
  | filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
  | filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
  | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${service_filter_predicate}
  | filter ${environment_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
  | select {
      d.service_name as service,
      case when d.env_name = "" then "Unassigned" else d.env_name end as environment,
      d.infra_name as infrastructure,
      d.stage_status as status,
      d.end_ts as end_ts,
      d.stage_duration as stage_duration,
      row_number() over (partition by d.service_name, d.env_name order by d.start_ts desc) as rn,
      count() over (partition by d.service_name, d.env_name) as deployments,
      count(case when d.stage_status = "SUCCESS" then 1 end) over (partition by d.service_name, d.env_name) as successes
    }
)
find s
| filter s.rn = 1
| select {
    s.service as service,
    s.environment as environment,
    s.infrastructure as infrastructure,
    s.status as last_status,
    s.end_ts as last_deployed,
    s.stage_duration / 1000.0 as last_duration,
    s.deployments as deployments,
    round(100.0 * s.successes / s.deployments, 1) as success_rate
  }
| order_by last_deployed desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Latest deployment status, timing and success rate for every service/environment pair

widget.title: Failed Deployments

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${service_filter_predicate}
| filter ${environment_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
| filter d.stage_status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"]
| select {
    d.start_ts as started,
    d.service_name as service,
    d.env_name as environment,
    d.pipeline_name as pipeline,
    d.stage_status as status,
    d.stage_duration / 1000.0 as duration,
    d.failure_message as failure_message
  }
| order_by started desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Most recent failed, aborted or expired deployments with failure reason
